newsitem.title: USA: U.S. businessman gets 15 months for tax evasion.
newsitem.headline: U.S. businessman gets 15 months for tax evasion.

text.p: A judge sentenced a Connecticut businessman to 15 months in prison failing to pay $435,000 in taxes on $1.4 million in income from a diet supplement operation, prosecutors said Tuesday.

Judge John Martin also imposed a $40,000 fine and ordered the man, Bindesh Trivedi, to pay the government $28,000 for the cost of his incarceration. He must also pay the back taxes plus interest and penalties.

Trivedi, 53, of Danbury, operated two Connecticut-based pharmaceutical companies, HealthKraft Industries and Balanced Nutrition Council, which market a powder-based diet supplement sold primarily in Japan.
